native_recipe.final_lease_binding: Expected final lease hashes are computed from the complete rendered CLOSED lease before writes and embedded in result/run. lease.json is written last; no file access occurs after that write.
native_recipe.generated_files: Python json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False), followed by one LF; UTF-8 without BOM.
native_recipe.lf: Replace every CRLF byte pair with LF, then every remaining CR with LF; hash resulting bytes.
native_recipe.logical: Decode artifact as UTF-8 JSON; serialize with Python json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), allow_nan=False); UTF-8 encode, no BOM or trailing newline; hash bytes.
native_recipe.raw: Hash exact artifact bytes, without BOM insertion or newline transformation.
native_recipe.result_binding: result0.json logical_digest_sha256 hashes canonical JSON of the result with only logical_digest_sha256 removed. Full result raw/LF/logical hashes are stored in run.json.
native_recipe.run_binding: decoder_run_sha256 is SHA-256 of canonical JSON for the exact run_binding_payload embedded in run.json. This payload precedes result production and binds inputs, text and expected final lease. run.json additionally binds final result raw/LF/logical hashes. Its own raw hash is returned to the parent, never embedded circularly.
